place: an office elevator stuck between floors

hero.name: Aisha
hero.look: a young woman in a business suit with a lanyard

soul.diary: Presented to the board today and froze on slide four. My boss covered for me. Now I owe him.
soul.past_dream: I dreamed I was giving a speech in a language I did not know.

facts.text: She practices speeches to the bathroom mirror.

situation_hero: you just woke up on the floor of a stuck elevator; the lights flicker; a man in a suit is pressing every button and talking to you like you work for him

actors.name: Mr Hale
actors.look: a man in a sharp grey suit with loosened tie, sweating
actors.persona: Mr Hale: acts like Aisha's boss, treats the stuck elevator like a meeting, demands an agenda and a plan to get out. Pompous, funny, panicky under it. He is hiding that he is claustrophobic and that he froze once too, years ago.
